fields.title: Philippine Supreme Court decision record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of the Supreme Court E-Library's own displayed values (elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph, the Philippine Judiciary's official free decision archive). Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, _warning on partial degradation). With fetchFullText=false a lightweight summary row is emitted per decision; fetchFullText=true and "decision" mode both add the complete opinion plus division, ponente and document type.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: search mode: "q=<searchPhrase>|corpus=<corpus>|type=<searchType>". browse mode: "years=<from>-<to>". decision mode: the exact document id requested.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-search (dtSearch hit row), S2-search (dtSearch hit enriched with the full document), S1-listing (monthly browse row), S2-decision (browse row enriched with the full decision), S1-decision (decision mode, direct lookup), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this specific record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions: no_results, decision_not_found, unknown_corpus, search_index_unavailable (the corpus's dtSearch index is broken server-side), http_<code>, blocked_or_transient.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error or a _warning. For search_index_unavailable it carries dtSearch's own error string verbatim.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker -- e.g. "full_text_unavailable" (fetchFullText=true but this one document's fetch failed; the summary fields are still returned).

docId.title: Document ID
docId.description: The portal's own numeric document id. Use it with mode='decision' to re-fetch the full text, or as https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/1/<docId>. Present on browse and decision records, and on search records only after full-text enrichment.

dtSearchDocId.title: dtSearch document ID
dtSearchDocId.description: search mode -- the search engine's OWN internal document number. It is a separate id space from docId and the two are NOT interchangeable (confirmed live: the same decision is dtSearch 69244 but portal 70008).

caseNumber.title: Case number
caseNumber.description: The Court's own docket reference exactly as printed, e.g. "G.R. No. 241587", "G.R. Nos. 216007-09", "A.M. No. P-26-390 [Formerly OCA IPI No. 19-4946-P]".

caseTitle.title: Case title
caseTitle.description: The party line as printed, e.g. "SILVINO C. EVANGELISTA, PETITIONER, VS. PEOPLE OF THE PHILIPPINES, RESPONDENT." Consolidated cases carry every docket number inline.

decisionDateText.title: Decision date (as displayed)
decisionDateText.description: The date exactly as the portal prints it, e.g. "August 06, 2025".

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: DECISION or RESOLUTION, taken from the letter-spaced caption the Court prints ("D E C I S I O N").

division.title: Division
division.description: The deciding division as printed: "EN BANC", "FIRST DIVISION", "SECOND DIVISION", "THIRD DIVISION".

ponente.title: Ponente
ponente.description: The justice who wrote the opinion, as signed, e.g. "ROSARIO, J.", "LEONEN, SAJ.", "PER CURIAM".

reporterCitation.title: Philippine Reports citation
reporterCitation.description: The official reporter citation when the decision has been reported, e.g. "930 Phil. 215". Absent for recent decisions not yet in Philippine Reports.

reporterPdfUrl.title: Philippine Reports PDF
reporterPdfUrl.description: Link to the official Philippine Reports PDF, when the E-Library offers one for this decision.

snippet.title: Search snippet
snippet.description: search mode -- dtSearch's own keyword-in-context extract around the matched terms.

hitCount.title: Hit count
hitCount.description: search mode -- how many times the query matched inside this document, as counted by dtSearch. Useful for ranking relevance.

month.title: Month
month.description: browse mode -- the archive month this row was listed under (Jan..Dec).

year.title: Year
year.description: browse mode -- the archive year this row was listed under.

fullText.title: Full decision text
fullText.description: Present when fetchFullText=true or in decision mode -- the complete opinion as plain text (whitespace normalised, portal chrome removed, nothing else altered). Frequently very long: a consolidated en banc decision was observed at 358,578 characters.

fullTextLength.title: Full text length
fullTextLength.description: Character count of fullText, handy for filtering out one-page minute resolutions.

documentUrl.title: Document URL
documentUrl.description: Direct link to the document. For browse/decision records this is the portal's canonical showdocs page; for search records it is dtSearch's own document view (the two id spaces do not map onto each other).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across summary and full-decision records.
